name: In-situ combustion and solvent-assisted SAGD
principle: Air injection burns part of the oil in the reservoir to generate heat; THAI (toe-to-heel air injection) pairs a vertical air injector with a horizontal producer. Solvent-assisted variants (VAPEX, eMSAGP, LASER) add vaporised solvent or liquid to steam. Romania's Suplacu de Barcau field has run in-situ combustion since 1970 to 1971 with over 55% recovery.
